properties.description: A CI gate that drives a real `--shared` client over stdio, writes one node, and requires the export file to appear. It exists because the defect it pins was found by INSPECTION while building the feature: a --shared client is a proxy, so passing it --export-to and stopping there would have meant the flag every installed project now carries has no effect in the default configuration, while every test that drove a plain stdio server passed. Shown to fail — with the forwarding removed it reports the file never appeared — before it was trusted.
properties.name: test_export_to_reaches_the_daemon.py
